Athens on foot: 7 stops, about 4.2 km. Swipe for what to look for at each one →

1. Ancient Agora
2. Acropolis
3. Acropolis Museum
4. Temple of Olympian Zeus
5. Plaka
6. Syntagma Square
7. Panathenaic Stadium

📌 Save this for your trip. Which stop would you start with?

Plan this walk in Travelhour: swipe, sort, go. Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/travelhour-trip-planner/id6773093615

#athenstravel #athensitinerary #walkingtour

Distances are estimates: straight line between stops plus 30% for streets.
